limitations: First actually early FULL command per exact independent JOIN; this is an action-selected population.
Selected stage must have the exact child request and precede native issue; both source prefixes are checksum verified.
Native EOS and actual remaining tokens are retrospective labels, never proposed online inputs.
Output-token counters below the observed stage or nonpositive durations remain noncomparable, not clamped to valid labels.
Remaining wall rate contains scheduling gaps and is not isolated GPU service speed.
Selected request EOS does not by itself prove a no-tool final RETURN; post-EOS delay can include another round or protocol work.
A first stage is not a simulated later transfer opportunity; no gain or validity for shifted triggers is inferred.
Live interval coverage is measured only at selected stages and cannot stand in for all-frame or project-isolated calibration.
Independent file prefixes are not atomic; omitted or unknown observations are retained.
